name: bm_ds_bench
description: bm_ds_bench is a dataset-style benchmark intended to evaluate models on practical data-science tasks such as data analysis, interpretation, and code-based data manipulation. It contains prompt–response pairs that require both natural-language reasoning and code (e.g., Python/pandas) to solve typical data-science problems. The benchmark is intended for automated and execution-based evaluation of correctness and usefulness of model outputs.
reputation: A small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside niche data-science evaluation experiments.
